accounts_has_login.name: accounts_has_login
accounts_has_login.value: "identity"."accounts"."email" is not null or "identity"."accounts"."wallet" is not null

disbursements_payee.name: disbursements_payee
disbursements_payee.value: ("payments"."disbursements"."kind"::text = 'creator' and "payments"."disbursements"."account_id" is not null) or ("payments"."disbursements"."kind"::text <> 'creator' and "payments"."disbursements"."seller_id" is not null)
